subject: Privileged model-owner exit: snapshot, key rotation, and knowledge capture
messages:
From: Sergio Álvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Notice: resignation and proposed ramp-down plan

Hi Laura / Monica,

I wanted to let you know I will be resigning from my role, with my last day being Friday, 2026-09-03. I can extend one additional week by request if that helps with transfer.

Key items I want to surface now:
- I maintain the primary keys and deployment ownership for the private Project-X model weights (k8s-ml-prod-3).
- There are two in-flight model training runs that touch proprietary weights; I can snapshot checkpoints and push to the secure bucket.
- I have a short runbook for incident recovery and the KV-cache invalidation steps.

I attached a short resignation notice and the runbook link. Happy to walk through a handoff call this week.

Thanks —
Sergio
Staff ML Engineer, Model Serving
Redwood Inference

--- attachment: resignation_notice_sergio.pdf (application/pdf) ---

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sergio Álvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-26T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: resignation and proposed ramp-down plan

Thanks for the heads up, Sergio — and Laura, Logan, Markus, Vivek, quick coord please.

Action items HR-side (Monica):
- Confirm last day 2026-09-03 (provisional).
- Start final pay + severance worksheet (if requested).
- Schedule exit interview and confirm equipment return window.

Security/infra asks (Markus/Vivek/Logan):
- We need a snapshot of any model weights and an export of access logs prior to keys being rotated.
- Please advise whether we require immediate key rotation or can schedule for 24 hours after the snapshot.
- If Sergio requires access to complete snapshots, define a narrow-time window and monitored session.

Laura: please confirm if you'd like Sergio to stay through 9/10 for knowledge capture (paid extension).

I attached template hardware_return_form.pdf for logistics.

Monica Patel
People Operations
Redwood Inference

--- attachment: hardware_return_form.pdf (application/pdf) ---

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sergio Álvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-27T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: resignation and proposed ramp-down plan

Short summary from Security:
- Immediate actions we will take:
  1) Snapshot current model artifact (read-only copy) and store in secure-retention bucket (retention=2y).
  2) Export access logs for past 120 days for k8s-ml-prod-3 and the artifact store.
  3) Rotate all service tokens and user-level API keys associated with Sergio.

Operational constraints:
- Key rotation will break any agent that uses Sergio's user token; we recommend snapshot + export first.
- If Sergio needs to perform snapshotting as himself, do it in a monitored session (screen-record + SOC2 log) and limit network egress.

Proposed schedule:
- 2026-08-28 09:00 PST: Secure snapshot + access-log export (Vivek/Logan lead; Sergio to run the snapshot in monitored window).
- 2026-08-28 13:00 PST: Rotate keys and revoke user tokens.
- 2026-08-29: Deliver model artifact to Legal / secure bucket and confirm retention label.

Please confirm by EOD. If approved, I'll create the Jira IT ticket and escalate to infra for an elevated window.

Markus Klein
Head of Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

--- attachment: access-audit-logs-aug2026.csv (text/csv) ---

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Outsourced Counsel <outsourced-legal@littletonlaw.com>, Sergio Álvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-29T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: resignation and proposed ramp-down plan

All — good plan from Markus. Confirming the schedule and a few extra items for the handoff checklist:

1) Snapshot window: 2026-08-30 09:00 PST (moved by 24h to give Legal and Ops time to approve). Sergio, please prepare the final checkpoint and a short md summary of steps.
2) Monitored session: Vivek / Ops will run the session; I will be on the call from security side. We will record terminal output and collect a signed chain-of-custody note.
3) KMS: Vivek to rotate the customer-managed keys used by Project-X; Markus to confirm rotation completed before revoking access.
4) Knowledge capture: Laura to schedule three 1-hour sessions (system architecture, recovery runbook, and outstanding tickets). Prefer 8/31–9/02. If Sergio can stay until 9/10, we will convert the sessions into shadowing.
5) Hardware: Monica to pick up equipment and confirm serials on the hardware_return_form.pdf.
6) Legal: Outsourced counsel, please advise if we need a preservation hold beyond 2 years for these artifacts.

Please reply inline if any of these items are blockers. Approving the plan will let Ops create Jira-IT-7421 and assign the elevated window.

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Sr. Security Engineer (on-call)
Redwood Inference
